text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh man~.
Another loss. A huge losing streak~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaah, losing this many times in a row... This is, this is just—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because I'm going to become the Queen, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean
I'll never lose again?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll never get to feel this way again—
which means it's super rare!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But!
I've had quite enough of feeling rare!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win like crazy from here on out!
Don't you worry!
choice_data_list: With that attitude, you'll be fine.
With that attitude, you'll be fine.
To win, training is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win like crazy from here on out!
Don't you worry!
choice_data_list: With that attitude, you'll be fine.
With that attitude, you'll be fine.
To win, training is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Keep your expectations high! Next time, for sure—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I'll make everyone say, 'Of course she won, she's Gran Alegria!'"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? But I'm not gonna lose anymore, you know?
choice_data_list: It's so we can win decisively.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! I see!!
That sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Let's win our next race at 100 mph—
no, with 120 mph of power!!"
